title: High-Probability Regulatory Conversion, Mispriced Second Catalyst
investment_conclusion: Own ZYME common equity through the August 25, 2026 PDUFA and the subsequent doublet overall-survival analysis, subject to the financial-review and label-quality gates. Do not buy pre-PDUFA options because listed expiries do not isolate the FDA event and quoted structures fail liquidity, breakeven, and event-coverage tests.

catalysts.name: FDA action on first-line HER2-positive GEA sBLA
Second interim OS analysis for zanidatamab plus chemotherapy

evidence.claim: The FDA assigned an August 25, 2026 PDUFA date and Priority Review to the first-line GEA sBLA.
Zanidatamab is already FDA approved in previously treated HER2-positive biliary tract cancer, reducing but not eliminating incremental molecule and manufacturing risk.
Both zanidatamab-containing arms achieved median PFS of 12.4 months versus 8.1 months for trastuzumab plus chemotherapy, with hazard ratios of 0.63 and 0.65.
The triplet achieved statistically significant OS with HR 0.72, while the doublet had HR 0.80 and did not cross at the first interim analysis.
Qualifying U.S. approval triggers a $250 million milestone payable by Jazz to Zymeworks.
FactSet reported approximately 73.0 million basic shares, $23.66 reference price, 5.8% short interest, and 7.6 days to cover.
The Theravance acquisition uses acquired cash and non-recourse financing in addition to Zymeworks cash; antitrust clearance was reported in August 2026.
evidence.source: Transaction filings and FactSet event report

evidence.claim: The listed option chain had no expiry directly bracketing the PDUFA and displayed spreads too wide for a defensible pre-event options trade.

valuation_bridge.method: event-window sum of cash and milestone conversion, probability-adjusted royalty value, Theravance value, pipeline residual, less debt and obligations
valuation_bridge.warning: Terminal values are model judgments and must be refreshed with the latest filing, label, royalty terms, and market price.

scenarios.name: Broad approval and doublet OS crosses
Broad approval and doublet OS does not cross
Narrower approval and doublet OS crosses
drivers: subsequent survival result improves commercial narrative

scenarios.name: Narrower approval and doublet OS does not cross
Delay, CRL, or material regulatory deficiency
drivers: asset and Theravance floor limit but do not prevent downside

falsifiers: The August 6 filing shows materially weaker unrestricted liquidity or materially greater Zymeworks cash funding for Theravance than underwritten.
Approval does not trigger the expected $250 million milestone or proceeds are materially restricted.
The FDA label materially excludes the commercially relevant first-line population or provides unexpectedly adverse safety language.
The updated doublet OS hazard ratio deteriorates materially rather than stabilizing or improving.
Broad approval produces no positive stock response over two full sessions, indicating severe crowding or a valuation error.
The stock trades above the modeled broad-approval value before the event without new fundamental information.

instrument_gate.preferred: Common equity held through both catalysts, with staged sizing and explicit post-event exits.
rejected: August options because they expire before the official PDUFA date.
September naked calls because breakevens require a larger move than the central fundamental distribution and timing may miss the OS readout.
Pre-PDUFA verticals because quoted spreads and debits fail execution gates.
Short-premium structures because regulatory gap risk is not bounded.
